children: In connection with completion of its merger, the company notified Nasdaq that each share of its common stock was converted into merger consideration, and Nasdaq will file a Form 25 to delist and deregister the stock. LivePerson previously traded on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol LPSN, and the company also intends to file a Form 15 to suspend its reporting obligations.
